# Data Tooly

> Data Tooly (https://datatooly.xyz) is a static site of 28 free, no-login data tools for developers, analysts and researchers, plus 28 code-first guides to public data APIs. 5 tools fetch live data in the browser; 23 are query builders that assemble a ready-to-run query and show a fixed example of the output shape. Each tool hands off to a production Apify actor for bulk runs.

Built and maintained by Omar Eldeeb (Apify Store handle: constructive_calm), who publishes 28 public data actors. Every page below has a clean markdown twin (the linked index.md); the HTML page is at the same URL without index.md. Full concatenated text: https://datatooly.xyz/llms-full.txt

## Tools by category

### Hiring & Sales Signals

- [Hiring & sales signal tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/hiring-sales-signals/index.md): Free tools that read company hiring signals from public job boards: live Greenhouse roles, an instant intent read, and an Apify actor for market-wide sweeps.
- [Company Hiring Signals — read buying intent from job postings](https://datatooly.xyz/company-hiring-signals/index.md): Live tool. See what any company is hiring for and what it signals. Free in-browser tool reads live Greenhouse roles and flags hiring intent. No login. Try it now.

### Patents & IP

- [Patent search & IP data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/patents-ip/index.md): Build structured Google Patents queries by keyword, assignee or inventor, preview the exact record shape, then export at scale with an Apify actor.
- [Search Google Patents by company, inventor, or keyword — the structured way](https://datatooly.xyz/google-patents-search-builder/index.md): Query builder. Search Google Patents by company, inventor, or keyword the structured way. Free query builder + sample preview, plus a path to bulk CSV/JSON export. Try it.

### Social & Community

- [Social media & community data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/social-community/index.md): Query builders for Reddit, Threads, Telegram and YouTube Shorts data: compose the search, preview the exact output fields, then run it on an Apify actor.
- [Search Reddit by keyword or subreddit — and export it clean](https://datatooly.xyz/reddit-search-builder/index.md): Query builder. Build a Reddit keyword/subreddit search query free in your browser, preview the output, then export posts + comments to CSV/JSON. No API key, no login.
- [Extract Telegram public channel posts](https://datatooly.xyz/telegram-channel-search/index.md): Query builder. Build a ready-to-run config to scrape Telegram channel posts, views, and reactions. Preview the output shape, then run it live on the Apify actor.
- [Scrape Threads profiles, posts & hashtags](https://datatooly.xyz/threads-profile-search/index.md): Query builder. Free Threads scraper query builder. Configure profile, posts & hashtag scrapes, preview the output shape, then run live on Apify. No login needed.
- [Monitor Threads by keyword or hashtag](https://datatooly.xyz/threads-keyword-monitor/index.md): Query builder. Build a Threads keyword or hashtag search, then schedule monitoring for new matching posts. Cookie-free public-web config for the Apify actor. Free to start.
- [YouTube Shorts Scraper — find viral Shorts by channel or keyword](https://datatooly.xyz/youtube-shorts-search/index.md): Query builder. Scrape YouTube Shorts by channel, keyword, hashtag, or URL. Get exact view, like, and comment counts, viral scores, and 360p downloads — no API key or quota.

### Dev & Community

- [Developer community data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/dev-community/index.md): Search Hacker News live in your browser through the free Algolia HN API: stories, comments, points and dates, with an Apify actor for bulk exports.
- [Search Hacker News by keyword — live, with points and comments](https://datatooly.xyz/hacker-news-search/index.md): Live tool. Search Hacker News by keyword live — real stories, points, comments, author, date. Free browser tool on the public HN Algolia API, no key. Filters + scale upsell.

### App Intelligence

- [App Store intelligence tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/app-intelligence/index.md): See Apple's live App Store top charts for any country (free, paid, grossing) straight from the iTunes RSS feed, then track rank history with an Apify actor.
- [App Store Top Charts — live, any country, free](https://datatooly.xyz/app-store-top-charts/index.md): Live tool. See the App Store top charts live, free, in any country. Real-time Top Free, Top Paid & Top Grossing apps straight from Apple's official iTunes RSS feed.

### Health & Pharma

- [Health, clinical trial & pharma data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/health-pharma/index.md): Search ClinicalTrials.gov live by condition, drug or phase, and build peptide and GLP-1 market-demand queries, each backed by an Apify actor for scale.
- [Search ClinicalTrials.gov live — by condition, drug, or phase](https://datatooly.xyz/clinical-trials-search/index.md): Live tool. Search ClinicalTrials.gov live by condition, drug, or phase. Free browser tool hits the official v2 REST API (no key, CORS-open) and shows real NCT studies.
- [Peptide & GLP-1 market intelligence](https://datatooly.xyz/peptide-market-intel-tool/index.md): Query builder. Build a ready-to-run query for peptide market research data: track GLP-1, BPC-157 and 30+ compounds across YouTube, Amazon and optional Reddit with sentiment.

### E-commerce Intelligence

- [E-commerce intelligence tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/ecommerce-intelligence/index.md): View any Shopify store's public product catalog live in your browser via /products.json: prices, variants and stock, plus an Apify actor for tracking.
- [See any Shopify store's products — live, free, no app](https://datatooly.xyz/shopify-store-products/index.md): Live tool. Free live tool: enter a Shopify domain and read its public /products.json in your browser — real titles, vendors, variants, prices, stock. No app, no key.

### News & Crypto

- [Crypto news data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/news-crypto/index.md): Build a structured Cointelegraph crypto-news query by keyword, language and count, preview the article fields, then export it with an Apify actor.
- [Search & export Cointelegraph crypto news](https://datatooly.xyz/crypto-news-search/index.md): Query builder. Free Cointelegraph scraper query builder. Configure keyword, language, and article count, preview the JSON output shape, then run it live on the Apify actor.

### Real Estate

- [Real estate listing data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/real-estate/index.md): Query builders for Egypt and Saudi Arabia property listings: prices, areas, locations and agent data from the major portals, exported via Apify actors.
- [Egypt real-estate listings — search & export](https://datatooly.xyz/egypt-real-estate-search/index.md): Query builder. Build a query for Egypt property listings data from Aqarmap, Dubizzle &amp; Property Finder, preview the output shape, then run it on Apify to export CSV/JSON.
- [Saudi real-estate listings — search & export](https://datatooly.xyz/saudi-real-estate-search/index.md): Query builder. Build a query for Saudi Arabia property data across Bayut.sa, Wasalt, Aqar.fm and PropertyFinder.sa, preview the output shape, then run it live to export listings.

### Ads Intelligence

- [Ad library & ads intelligence tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/ads-intelligence/index.md): Query builders for the Facebook Ad Library and TikTok's EU ad library: set keyword, country and filters, preview ad fields, then export via Apify actors.
- [Facebook Ad Library Scraper — search & export competitor ads](https://datatooly.xyz/facebook-ad-library-search/index.md): Query builder. Build a ready-to-run Facebook Ad Library scraper query — keyword, country, active status — and preview the export shape, then run it live on Apify.
- [Search the TikTok Ad Library (EU/DSA)](https://datatooly.xyz/tiktok-ad-library-search/index.md): Query builder. Build a TikTok Ad Library query by keyword or advertiser, check if your market is in the 33 EU/DSA regions, preview the output, then run it live.

### Sports Analytics

- [Football & sports analytics data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/sports-analytics/index.md): Query builders for Fantasy Premier League data and Understat xG football analytics: preview the exact output fields, then export with an Apify actor.
- [Fantasy Premier League data & picks](https://datatooly.xyz/fpl-intelligence-tool/index.md): Query builder. Build a ready-to-run Fantasy Premier League API query for gameweek picks and manager dashboards, preview the output shape, then run it live on Apify.
- [Understat xG football analytics — export](https://datatooly.xyz/understat-football-stats/index.md): Query builder. Build a ready-to-run query for Understat xG data — players, teams, shots across 6 leagues since 2014/15 — preview the output shape, then run it live.

### Automotive

- [Used car listing data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/automotive/index.md): Build a Gulf used-car listings query for DubiCars and Dubizzle by make and model, preview the listing fields, then export it with an Apify actor.
- [Gulf used-car listings — search & export](https://datatooly.xyz/gulf-used-car-search/index.md): Query builder. Build a query for Dubai used car listings data across DubiCars and Dubizzle, preview the export shape, then run it live. Make, model, price, mileage in AED.

### Lead Generation

- [Lead generation data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/lead-generation/index.md): Query builders for public LinkedIn profile data: name, headline, experience, posts and articles, previewed in the browser and extracted by an Apify actor.
- [Extract LinkedIn profiles — posts & articles](https://datatooly.xyz/linkedin-profile-lookup/index.md): Query builder. Free query builder for a LinkedIn profile scraper: paste profile URLs, preview the JSON output shape, then run it on Apify — no cookies or login.
- [Find LinkedIn profiles by job title and location](https://datatooly.xyz/linkedin-people-search/index.md): Query builder. Free LinkedIn people search builder: enter job titles and locations, preview name, headline, company and profile URL rows, then run it on Apify. No cookies.

### AI & SEO

- [AI search visibility tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/ai-seo/index.md): Build a brand-visibility query for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Grok answers, preview the output shape, then run it on an Apify actor.
- [Is your brand visible in ChatGPT & AI search?](https://datatooly.xyz/llm-visibility-monitor-tool/index.md): Query builder. Build a ready-to-run query to track brand mentions in ChatGPT and 4 other AI engines. Preview the output shape, then run it live on Apify. Free to start.

### Crypto & DeFi

- [Crypto & DeFi on-chain data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/crypto-defi/index.md): Build a DEX pair MEV and sandwich-risk scan by chain, token or pool, preview the per-pair output fields, then run it on an Apify actor.
- [Scan DEX pairs for MEV & sandwich risk](https://datatooly.xyz/mev-pair-scanner-tool/index.md): Query builder. Build a ready-to-run query for DEX sandwich attack MEV data — preview the per-pair output shape (sandwich rate, MEV fee ratio, risk level), then run it live.

### SaaS & SEO

### Finance & Filings

### Jobs & Visas

- [Visa sponsorship & salary data tools (category hub)](https://datatooly.xyz/category/jobs-visas/index.md): Query builders for H-1B visa sponsors and H-1B/PERM salary benchmarks from U.S. Department of Labor disclosure data, run on Apify actors.
- [Find H-1B & green-card visa sponsors + salary data](https://datatooly.xyz/visa-sponsor-finder/index.md): Query builder. Free H-1B visa sponsor lookup query builder. Set a role + city, preview the output shape, then run it live on real DOL LCA & PERM sponsor data.
- [What does a role pay? H-1B/PERM salary benchmarks](https://datatooly.xyz/salary-benchmark-lookup/index.md): Query builder. Benchmark what a role pays using public DOL H-1B/PERM wage disclosure data — percentiles by city, state, or employer, or individual records. Free to start.

## Guides

- [All guides](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/index.md): index of every guide.
- [App Store Top Charts API: Free, Key-Free, and CORS-Open](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/app-store-top-charts-api/index.md): Pull Apple App Store top charts straight from the browser with the legacy iTunes RSS feed — no key, CORS-open, runnable fetch() + curl included.
- [ClinicalTrials.gov API to CSV: Export Trials by Phase in Python](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/clinicaltrials-gov-api-export-csv-python/index.md): Export ClinicalTrials.gov search results to CSV with the free v2 API: format=csv, the x-next-page-token header, and the phase filter that actually works.
- [Read Company Hiring Signals From Public Job Board APIs (with code)](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/company-hiring-signals-job-board-apis/index.md): Open job postings leak strategy. Learn to read company hiring signals from the public, no-auth Greenhouse API with a runnable JS classifier.
- [Cointelegraph API: Get Crypto News as JSON Without a Key](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/cointelegraph-api-crypto-news-json/index.md): Cointelegraph has no public news API, but its site runs on a keyless GraphQL endpoint and RSS feeds. Pull articles, search results and full text as JSON.
- [Price per sqm by Compound in New Cairo: Compute It with Python](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/new-cairo-price-per-sqm-by-compound-python/index.md): Stop trusting broker blogs: compute New Cairo apartment price per square meter by compound from live Property Finder Egypt listings, split ready vs off-plan.
- [Facebook Ad Library Scraper: API Limits and the Real Approach](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/facebook-ad-library-scraper/index.md): Why the official Meta Ad Library API only covers political ads, and how to build a Facebook ad library scraper for commercial competitor ads instead.
- [FPL API Price Change Data in Python: The Official 2026/27 Fields](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/fpl-api-price-change-data-python/index.md): Read FPL's own price-change predictions from the free bootstrap-static API in Python: price_change_percent, projections, likelihood, and the ±100 rule.
- [How to Export Google Patents to CSV (Honest Guide to Every Real Path)](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/export-google-patents-to-csv/index.md): A precise, no-hype guide to exporting Google Patents search results to CSV — the built-in 1,000-row cap, the BigQuery bulk path, and why browser scraping fails.
- [How to Extract Dubai Used Car Listings Data from Gulf Marketplaces](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/dubai-used-car-listings-data/index.md): A practical, honest guide to extracting Dubai used car listings data from DubiCars, YallaMotor, and Dubizzle Motors using JSON-LD and embedded __NEXT_DATA__.
- [The Hacker News Search API: Free, No-Key, and Surprisingly Powerful](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/hacker-news-search-api/index.md): A practical guide to the free, no-key Hacker News search API (hn.algolia.com): tags, numeric filters, relevance vs. date sorting, and runnable code.
- [LinkedIn X-Ray Search for Recently Updated Profiles (Past Week)](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/linkedin-x-ray-search-recently-updated-profiles/index.md): Add Google's past-week filter to a LinkedIn X-ray search to surface recently re-indexed profiles, then dedupe by slug so each run shows only new people.
- [How to Build a LinkedIn Profile Scraper: The Honest Technical Guide](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/build-linkedin-profile-scraper/index.md): A practical, honest guide to building a LinkedIn profile scraper: why there's no public API, how public pages embed JSON-LD, and the legal reality.
- [Measure AI Share of Voice in Python: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/measure-ai-share-of-voice-python/index.md): Measure your brand's AI share of voice in Python: one prompt set, several LLMs, mention counting that ignores 'I'm not familiar with X' answers.
- [How to Check a DEX Pool's Sandwich Attack Rate (Python + API)](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/check-dex-pool-sandwich-attack-rate/index.md): Measure how often a Uniswap, Raydium or Aerodrome pool gets sandwiched: pull per-hour sandwichRate and MEV fee data from Codex getBars in Python.
- [Track Peptide & GLP-1 Mentions on YouTube with Python (No API Key)](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/track-peptide-glp1-mentions-youtube-python/index.md): Count YouTube videos mentioning semaglutide, tirzepatide or BPC-157 without an API key: parse ytInitialData, map brand names to compounds, export to CSV.
- [How to Scrape Reddit Without the API (After the 2023 Price Changes)](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/scrape-reddit-without-api/index.md): A precise, honest guide to scraping Reddit without the API: what still works in 2026, the login-wall and 403/CORS traps, and old.reddit.com.
- [Scrape Monthly vs Annual SaaS Prices From Pricing-Page JSON-LD](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/scrape-saas-pricing-monthly-annual-json-ld/index.md): Get both sides of a SaaS pricing page's monthly/annual toggle without a browser: read schema.org Offer JSON-LD in Python, then diff it on a schedule.
- [How to Build an H-1B Salary Database by Employer (with Python)](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/h1b-salary-database-by-employer/index.md): A practical guide to querying H-1B salary data by employer and role, using the authoritative DOL OFLC LCA disclosure files with runnable Python.
- [How to Extract Saudi Arabia Property Data from 4 Listing Portals](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/saudi-arabia-property-data/index.md): A practical guide to collecting Saudi Arabia property data from the major portals, including the REGA license trick that dedupes listings across platforms.
- [The SEC EDGAR API: A Practical Guide to Free Filing Data in Python](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/sec-edgar-api-python-guide/index.md): A hands-on guide to the free SEC EDGAR API: the required User-Agent header, ticker-to-CIK mapping, XBRL financials, and full-text search in Python.
- [Shopify products.json Pagination: 250 Limit and the 25,000 Cap](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/shopify-products-json-pagination/index.md): Paginate any Shopify store's public /products.json: limit=250, page numbers, the empty-page stop signal, and the HTTP 400 you hit at 25,000 products.
- [How to Scrape a Telegram Channel Without Login (No API Key)](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/scrape-telegram-channel-without-login/index.md): A verified, runnable guide to scraping public Telegram channels without login, an API key or a phone number, using the t.me/s/ preview and plain HTTP.
- [Threads Keyword Search Without App Review: Monitor in Python](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/threads-keyword-search-without-app-review/index.md): Threads' keyword_search API only searches your own posts until Meta approves your app. Monitor public Threads keywords in Python without app review.
- [How to Build a Threads Scraper for Meta Profiles and Posts](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/build-threads-scraper-profiles-posts/index.md): A practical, honest guide to building a Threads scraper for Meta's threads.com — what loads cookie-free, what doesn't, and a runnable example.
- [The TikTok Ad Library API: A Developer's Guide to the DSA Library](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/tiktok-ad-library-api/index.md): A practical, accurate guide to the TikTok ad library API: what the DSA Commercial Content Library covers, the official researcher path, and how to query it.
- [Understat xG Data Export: Pull Expected Goals with Python + CSV](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/understat-xg-data-export/index.md): A practical guide to Understat xG data export: how the data is embedded in the page, a Python scraper that decodes it, and league and player xG to CSV.
- [PERM Disclosure Data in Python: Find Green Card Sponsors by City](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/perm-disclosure-data-python-green-card-sponsors/index.md): Use the DOL's free PERM disclosure file to list green card sponsors by city and occupation in Python: where the file lives, key columns, and the traps.
- [How to Scrape YouTube Shorts Data (Exact View, Like & Comment Counts)](https://datatooly.xyz/guides/scrape-youtube-shorts-data/index.md): A practical guide to scraping YouTube Shorts data: why the official API falls short, how the internal API works, and a runnable example with exact counts.
